**Hans-Joachim Merks** (2 February 1917 – 21 February 1961) was a Kapitänleutnant with the Kriegsmarine during World War II and a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross (German language: [_Ritterkreuz des Eisernen Kreuzes_] Error: {{Lang}}: text has italic markup (help)). The Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross was awarded to recognise extreme battlefield bravery or successful military leadership.

## Awards[]
*   Iron Cross (1939)   
    *   2nd Class (20 November 1939)[[1]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#cite_note-D%C3%B6rr_p57-1)  
    *   1st Class (22 May 1941)[[1]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#cite_note-D%C3%B6rr_p57-1)

*   German Cross in Gold (21 November 1942)  
*   Minesweeper War Badge (12 November 1940)[[1]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#cite_note-D%C3%B6rr_p57-1)  
*   Italian War Merit Cross with Swords (_Voce al valore militare_) (29 December 1942)[[1]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#cite_note-D%C3%B6rr_p57-1)  
*   Cuff title "Afrika" (30 August 1943)[[1]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#cite_note-D%C3%B6rr_p57-1)  
*   Wound Badge in Black (6 November 1944)[[1]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#cite_note-D%C3%B6rr_p57-1)  
*   Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross (28 May 1945) [[a]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#endnote_Note1a)

## Footnotes[]
*   **a** There is no reference of the Knight's Cross awarded to Hans-Joachim Merks in the German National Archives. His personal file contains a letter from 1955 by the Deutsche Dienststelle (WASt), indicating that no proof of the award exists. The date was assigned by the Association of Knight's Cross Recipients (AKCR).[[2]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#cite_note-2)

**Hans-Joachim Merks** (2 February 1917 – 21 February 1961) was a Kapitänleutnant with the Kriegsmarine during World War II and a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross (German language: [_Ritterkreuz des Eisernen Kreuzes_] Error: {{Lang}}: text has italic markup (help)). The Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross was awarded to recognise extreme battlefield bravery or successful military leadership.

## Awards[]
*   Iron Cross (1939)   
    *   2nd Class (20 November 1939)[[1]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#cite_note-D%C3%B6rr_p57-1)  
    *   1st Class (22 May 1941)[[1]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#cite_note-D%C3%B6rr_p57-1)

*   German Cross in Gold (21 November 1942)  
*   Minesweeper War Badge (12 November 1940)[[1]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#cite_note-D%C3%B6rr_p57-1)  
*   Italian War Merit Cross with Swords (_Voce al valore militare_) (29 December 1942)[[1]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#cite_note-D%C3%B6rr_p57-1)  
*   Cuff title "Afrika" (30 August 1943)[[1]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#cite_note-D%C3%B6rr_p57-1)  
*   Wound Badge in Black (6 November 1944)[[1]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#cite_note-D%C3%B6rr_p57-1)  
*   Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross (28 May 1945) [[a]](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Hans-Joachim_Merks#endnote_Note1a)

## Footnotes[]
*   **a** There is no reference of the Knight's Cross awarded to Hans-Joachim Merks in the German National Archives. His personal file contains a letter from 1955 by the Deutsche Dienststelle (WASt), indicating that no proof of the award exists.
